feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: 'Medicare for all' is back on the drawing board. Does it stand a better chance this time?
entry.summary: Several newly elected Democratic U.S. senators campaigned on Medicare for All. Could this be the time it actually gets traction?

entry.title: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
entry.summary: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Jensen's return as a national security risk.

entry.title: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
entry.summary: Democrats have currently flipped 47 House seats and could flip 49 total. And, climate change talks at COP31 ran two days longer than expected, becoming the longest conference in the summit's history.

entry.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
entry.summary: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

entry.title: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
entry.summary: Older drivers are using Tesla's automated driving technology to stay on the road longer. But safety experts warn the company may be over-selling what its cars can do.

entry.title: Mushroom supplements promise health benefits. What does the science say?
entry.summary: Wellness influencers say mushroom supplements can help with your gut health, focus and immune system. Here is where research suggests there are some links.

entry.title: K is for kindness, but families worry the world has less of it
entry.summary: A decade after first asking families about kindness, Sesame Workshop asked parents similar questions. They responded that their kids are getting kinder even as the wider world becomes less so.

entry.title: Let's talk turkey: Here's how Thanksgiving meal costs have changed this year
entry.summary: Grocery costs have been on the rise, but food-price analysts say it's unclear if you'll spend more on the Thanksgiving meal this year. Some people are deciding not to host or are hosting fewer guests.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: A look at how artificial intelligence is affecting the economy, NATO to meet after Russian missiles hit Poland, negotiators fail to reach a deal as COP31 comes to an end.

entry.title: Do not feed the animals. Vets explain why hats, coins and shoes can be deadly
entry.summary: It's not easy to retrieve foreign objects from animals once ingested. Some things can be grabbed using an endoscope. But if an item gets far into the intestinal tract, surgery isn't always possible.
